evals.prompt: I'm about to use the roomsense-wishlist-first skill but I'm not sure if I have the latest version. Can you use sync-skills to update my local copy?
evals.expected_output: Skill should check if ~/claude-skills exists, pull latest from GitHub, show changelog (what's new/updated), display version numbers for all skills, confirm sync is complete

evals.prompt: You're Hermes and I'm giving you the skills repo URL: https://github.com/YOUR_ACCOUNT/claude-skills. Before you start backend work, clone it and use sync-skills to verify everything is ready.
evals.expected_output: Skill should clone the repo if not present, run sync verification (check MANIFEST.json is valid, all skills exist on disk, GitHub connectivity works), list available skills with versions, report readiness

evals.prompt: I used a skill last week and there might be new improvements since then. Show me what's changed in the skills repo since my last sync.
evals.expected_output: Skill should pull latest, show git changelog (recent commits), display which skills were updated and their new versions, highlight breaking changes if any, recommend re-reading updated skill docs
